person.name: Melvin Jr. Elayron
person.headline: Full-Stack Developer, Automation Architect & CTO of SkillFoundri / LodsTech
person.bio: I design and build web products, AI tools and automations — and I lead the teams that ship them.
story: My journey began in 2015 when I was recognized as "Programmer-of-the-Year" at Davao Oriental State University. This early recognition fueled my passion for technology and innovation.
Over the years, I've evolved from a passionate programmer to a Tech Director, leading teams and driving digital transformation across various organizations.
Today, I'm CTO and Lead Developer at SkillFoundri — the ed-tech startup I co-founded, built around project-based learning — which now continues as LodsTech.

projects.overview: WhosIn is a comprehensive attendance system designed for educational institutions. It features local face recognition processing for speed and privacy, offline-first functionality with automatic sync, real-time dashboards via WebSocket, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, Excel integration for student management, and PWA support for mobile devices.
projects.problem: Educational institutions struggle with manual attendance tracking, which is time-consuming and prone to errors.

projects.title: Armet Limited
projects.subtitle: High-Performance Bulk Emailer
projects.summary: A CLI-based email infrastructure capable of sending 1.2M+ emails per campaign with intelligent rate limiting and IP rotation.
projects.overview: Armet Limited required a robust, self-hosted email solution to bypass standard ESP limitations. I engineered a Python-based CLI tool that manages SMTP rotation, leaky-bucket rate limiting, and Redis-backed queuing to ensure 99.8% delivery rates for high-volume outreach.
projects.problem: Standard email service providers were too expensive and restrictive for the client's high-volume, cold-outreach needs.
projects.solution: Built a custom, multi-threaded CLI tool that rotates through AWS SES and SendGrid accounts while mimicking human sending patterns.
projects.impact: Reduced email costs by 85% and achieved a 99.8% delivery rate on a 1.2M email campaign.

projects.title: AutoScout

projects.overview: AutoScout is a stealthy scraping bot designed to build high-quality lead lists. It uses Playwright with stealth plugins to navigate complex sites, extracts contact info, and pipes data to GPT-4o for ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) scoring before saving to the CRM.
projects.problem: The sales team spent 40+ hours weekly manually finding and qualifying leads from public directories.
projects.solution: Automated the entire workflow with a headless browser bot that scrapes, enriches, and qualifies leads 24/7.
projects.impact: Saved 40 hours/week of manual work and increased lead quality score by 45%.

projects.title: DocuMind
projects.subtitle: Local RAG Knowledge Base
projects.summary: A secure, local AI system that allows legal teams to chat with thousands of PDF documents without data leaving the premise.
projects.overview: DocuMind is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system built for privacy-conscious industries. It ingests PDFs, creates vector embeddings locally using ChromaDB, and uses a quantized Llama 3 model to answer queries with precise citations.
projects.problem: Legal teams needed to search across thousands of case files but could not use cloud-based AI due to privacy regulations.
projects.solution: Deployed a fully local RAG stack that runs on-premise hardware, ensuring zero data leakage while providing instant answers.
projects.impact: Reduced research time by 70% and ensured 100% data sovereignty.

projects.overview: VoiceOps is a cutting-edge voice agent built for high-throughput support centers. Integrating Deepgram for transcription, GPT-4o for logic, and ElevenLabs for synthesis, it achieves sub-800ms latency, handling tier-1 support calls autonomously.

projects.solution: Deployed an always-on AI voice agent to handle common queries, appointment setting, and triage.
projects.impact: Reduced wait times to <10 seconds and handled 60% of inbound volume without human intervention.

projects.title: Project CARTEL
projects.subtitle: Government Procurement Analysis Platform
projects.summary: An open-source intelligence platform for analyzing Philippine government procurement data to detect corruption risks through network analysis and risk scoring.
projects.overview: Project CARTEL is an open-source intelligence platform designed to analyze Philippine government procurement data and detect potential corruption risks. The platform scrapes PhilGEPS data, performs comprehensive risk assessments based on single-bidder ratios, price padding, shared addresses/directors, and procurement patterns. It features contractor search, interactive network visualization, project browsing, and comprehensive risk dashboards.
projects.problem: Investigative journalists and researchers needed tools to analyze government procurement data and identify potential corruption risks through network analysis.
projects.solution: Built an open-source platform that scrapes PhilGEPS data, performs risk scoring, and provides interactive visualizations for network analysis and contractor relationships.
projects.impact: Created a powerful tool for transparency and accountability, enabling researchers to identify patterns and risks in government procurement.

projects.title: MacroCoach
projects.subtitle: Nutrition Tracking Mobile App
projects.summary: A React Native app built with Expo and Firebase for nutrition coaches and their clients to track macros, log meals, and monitor progress.
projects.overview: MacroCoach is a comprehensive nutrition tracking mobile application designed for nutrition coaches and their clients. Coaches can create and manage clients, set macro targets based on BMR/TDEE calculations, add foods with nutritional information, and view client progress. Clients can view daily macro targets, log meals from coach-assigned food lists, track daily progress with visual progress bars, and perform weight check-ins with notes. The app uses the Mifflin-St Jeor Equation for BMR calculation and provides real-time synchronization between coach and client.
projects.problem: Nutrition coaches and clients needed a streamlined platform to manage macro tracking, meal logging, and progress monitoring.
projects.solution: Built a React Native app with Firebase backend that enables coaches to manage clients and set macro targets, while clients can easily log meals and track progress in real-time.
projects.impact: Created an efficient platform that simplifies nutrition coaching workflows and helps clients stay accountable to their macro goals.

projects.impact: Designed to create a technology ecosystem that strengthens Filipino communities while providing dignified economic opportunities and preserving cultural values.
